		Dataset Description
	

This repository is a collection of multiple audio datasets used for evaluation in the MiMo-Audio-Eval toolkit. It includes a variety of datasets for tasks such as automatic speech recognition (AISHELL1, LibriSpeech), text-to-speech (SeedTTS), audio understanding and reasoning (MMAU and MMSU), and more.

author: XiaomiMiMo
description:
Dataset Card for SpeechMMLU
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Description
	

SpeechMMLU is an evaluation dataset designed to assess the knowledge capabilities of speech-language models. It is built based on the MMLU dataset, with entries filtered by subject and length, resulting in a total of 8,549 entries across 34 subjects. We synthesized the questions and answers into speech using commercial TTS with diverse voices.
